precheck:
import httpx
left = httpx.Headers([('X-A', '1'), ('X-B', '2')])
right = httpx.Headers([('x-b', '2'), ('x-a', '1')])
assert left == right, (left, right)
assert left != httpx.Headers([('x-a', 'different'), ('x-b', '2')])
print('normal controls: reordered/case-insensitive equality and differing-value inequality pass', flush=True)
probe:
import httpx
left = httpx.Headers([('X-A', '1'), ('x-a', '1')])
right = httpx.Headers([('x-a', '1')])
actual = (left == right)
assert actual is False, {'left': left.multi_items(), 'right': right.multi_items(), 'actual_equal': actual, 'expected_equal': False}
